name: Red, Green, Brainrot!
desc:
Welcome to Red, Green, Brainrot!

Move and pickup brainrots when the light changes GREEN
DON'T MOVE when the light goes RED 🔴
Stay alive and collect many Brainrots! ⚡
Upgrade your brainrots and get more money! 💸
Upgrade your base to unlock more slots and place extra characters! 🏗️

Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

Like the game and join the group for FREE BRAINROT! 👍
